sloka: तदाश्वसिहि भद्रं ते भव त्वं कालकाङ्क्षिणी ।नचिराद्द्रक्ष्यसे रामं प्रज्वलन्तिमिवानलम् ।। ५.३९.४४।।।।
transliteration: tadāśvasihi bhadraṁ te bhava tvaṁ kālakāṅkṣiṇī ।nacirāddrakṣyase rāmaṁ prajvalantimivānalam ।। 5.39.44।।।।

translations.english: "Therefore, count the days and rest assured. Let it be auspicious to you. You will shortly see Rama burning like fire.
